matchingIsConservative: Only an exact content hash or a strong form-number match within the same jurisdiction counts as held. An unresolvable label is recorded as unresolved identity rather than as missing, because absence of a match is not evidence of absence -- and calling a held source missing wastes acquisition while calling a missing source held suppresses it.
